how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Faster builds: may the build machine keep about 17 GB more on C: (a bigger cache of compiled shaders and textures, about 10 GB, and the compiled code kept between builds, about 7 GB)? It should take about 14 minutes off each 40-minute build.
sections.recommendation: Yes, on C: (144 GB free; F: is already just under your 20 GB floor, so not there). Tonight's build is measured first; if the full cache turns out not to be what slows it, I withdraw this. No web link: the answer is this page.

sections.name: Tom's boots still look heavy: the toe reshape (your yes of 31 October) passed review with no new fault, but the thick sole (17 to 20 mm) and the ledge round the toe now make them read clog-like. May I make one more try: the sole thinned to about 12 mm and the ledge trimmed at the toe (about 1 hour)?
sections.recommendation: Yes: it is the last thing keeping his feet heavy in both reviewers' eyes; points, weights and maps stay as they are, and it is judged the same way (pictures in the game, a fresh reviewer, the packaged walk). No web link: the answer is this page.
